batch_node.name: AWS dimensions v0.4.0
batch_node.description: Declares the dimension keys aws_core writes or has written. aws.account (the account that owns a resource) and aws.region (the region it was read through, or global) are stamped by the collector on every node and edge it writes; cloud is retired. v0.4.0 (George 2026-11-12, aws-build Q56): aws_account and aws_region are renamed aws.account and aws.region, keeping their ids; tap.cloud moves to computing_core as tap.computing.cloud, which keeps that id, so this seed no longer declares it; cloud stays declared, retired and merged into tap.computing.cloud, so a grid whose rows still carry it resolves it. A new batch id, because an already-imported batch is skipped on re-seed.

node.name: cloud
node.description: Retired 2026-11-12; never stamped. It carried aws, the same fact as tap.computing.cloud (the type default, owned by computing_core), into which it is merged. Kept declared so a grid whose rows still carry the key resolves it until those rows are rewritten.

node.name: aws.account
node.description: The AWS account that OWNS a resource (George 2026-11-12, aws-build Q57), stamped by the aws_core collector on every node and edge it writes. Filled from the account segment of the resource's own ARN (aws for AWS-managed resources), else an explicit owner field (OwnerId, ResourceOwnerId), else the account whose credential read it, which owns everything it lists except resources shared in. Organizations nodes: an account carries its own id; an OU, root or organization carries the management account. Open. Renamed from aws_account in v0.4.0, same id.

node.name: aws.region
node.description: The AWS region a resource was read through, stamped by the aws_core collector on every node and edge it writes; global for global-scope resources and the Organizations tree. Open. Renamed from aws_region in v0.4.0, same id.
